arxiv-2012-12621.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Meghna Sharma, Sushil Kumar, Naveen Kumar Jain. Some sufficient conditions on certain constants which are involved in some first, second and third order differential subordinations associated with certain functions with positive real part like modified Sigmoid function, exponential function and Janowski function are obtained so that the analytic function p p normalized by the condition p ⁡ ( 0 ) = 1 p(0)=1 , is subordinate to Janowski function.

arxiv-2104-02718.title: Attractors with Large Complex Structure
arxiv-2104-02718.creator: for One-Parameter Families of
arxiv-2104-02718.description: Abstract \proofmodefalse The attractor equations for an arbitrary one-parameter family of Calabi-Yau manifolds are studied in the large complex structure region. These equations are solved iteratively, generating what we term an N -expansion, which is a power series in the Gromov-Witten invariants of the manifold. The coefficients of this series are associated with integer partitions.

arxiv-2202-02896.title: Evaluation Methods and Measures for Causal Learning Algorithms
arxiv-2202-02896.creator: Lu Cheng, Ruocheng Guo, Raha Moraffah, Paras Sheth, K. Selçuk Candan, Huan Liu
arxiv-2202-02896.description: Abstract The convenient access to copious multi-faceted data has encouraged machine learning researchers to reconsider correlation-based learning and embrace the opportunity of causality-based learning, i.e., causal machine learning (causal learning). Recent years have therefore witnessed great effort in developing causal learning algorithms aiming to help AI achieve human-level intelligence.

arxiv-2211-17133.title: Tumor growth with nutrients: stability of the tumor patches
arxiv-2211-17133.creator: Inwon Kim, Jona Lelmi
arxiv-2211-17133.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study a tumor growth model with nutrients. The contact inhibition for the tumor cells, presented in the model, results in the evolution of a congested tumor patch . We study the regularity of the tumor patch as the nutrients’ diffusion strength D D diminishes.

arxiv-2306-17604.title: Broken ray transform for twisted geodesics on surfaces with a reflecting obstacle
arxiv-2306-17604.creator: Shubham R. Jathar, Manas Kar, Jesse Railo
arxiv-2306-17604.description: Abstract . We prove a uniqueness result for the broken ray transform acting on the sums of functions and 1 1 -forms on surfaces in the presence of an external force and a reflecting obstacle. We assume that the considered twisted geodesic flows have nonpositive curvature.

arxiv-2403-17505.title: Computing conservative probabilities of rare events with surrogates
arxiv-2403-17505.creator: Nicolas Bousquet
arxiv-2403-17505.description: Abstract This article provides a critical review of the main methods used to produce conservative estimators of probabilities of rare events, or critical failures, for reliability and certification studies in the broadest sense. These probabilities must theoretically be calculated from simulations of (certified) numerical models, but which typically suffer from prohibitive computational costs.

arxiv-2407-10719.title: Global analysis of nuclear parton distribution functions
arxiv-2407-10719.description: Abstract We review the theoretical foundations, methodological approaches and current status of the determination of nuclear parton distribution functions (PDFs). A large variety of measurements in fixed-target and collider experiments provide increasingly precise constraints on various aspects of nuclear PDFs, including shadowing, antishadowing, the EMC effect, Fermi motion, flavour separation, deuteron binding, target-mass and other higher-twist effects.

arxiv-2408-12398.title: A Comparative Analysis of Faithfulness Metrics and Humans in Citation Evaluation
arxiv-2408-12398.creator: Weijia Zhang, Mohammad Aliannejadi, Jiahuan Pei, Yifei Yuan, Jia-Hong Huang, Evangelos Kanoulas
arxiv-2408-12398.description: Abstract . Large language models (LLMs) often generate content with unsupported or unverifiable content, known as “hallucinations.” To address this, retrieval-augmented LLMs are employed to include citations in their content, grounding the content in verifiable sources. Despite such developments, manually assessing how well a citation supports the associated statement remains a major challenge.

arxiv-2503-09828.title: Resolution Invariant Autoencoder
arxiv-2503-09828.creator: Ashay Patel, Michela Antonelli, Sebastien Ourselin, M. Jorge Cardoso
arxiv-2503-09828.description: Abstract Deep learning has significantly advanced medical imaging analysis, yet variations in image resolution remain an overlooked challenge. Most methods address this by resampling images, leading to either information loss or computational inefficiencies. While solutions exist for specific tasks, no unified approach has been proposed.

arxiv-2503-23477.title: Loss aware pricing strategies for peer to peer energy trading
arxiv-2503-23477.creator: Varsha N. Behrunani, Philipp Heer, Roy S. Smith, John Lygeros
arxiv-2503-23477.description: Abstract Peer-to-peer(P2P) energy trading may increase efficiency and reduce costs, but introduces significant challenges for network operators such as maintaining grid reliability, accounting for network losses, and redistributing costs equitably. We propose a novel loss-aware pricing strategy for P2P energy markets that addresses these challenges while incentivizing participation in the cooperative energy trading market.

arxiv-2506-12843.title: Transforming Chatbot Text: A Sequence-to-Sequence Approach
arxiv-2506-12843.creator: Natesh Reddy Mark Stamp
arxiv-2506-12843.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Natesh Reddy Mark Stamp. Due to advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, the boundary between human-written text and AI-generated text has become blurred. Nevertheless, recent work has demonstrated that it is possible to reliably detect GPT-generated text. In this paper, we adopt a novel strategy to adversarially transform GPT-generated text using sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) models, with the goal of making the text more human-like.

arxiv-2508-21094.title: Video-LLMs with Temporal Visual Screening
arxiv-2508-21094.creator: Zheyu Fan, Jiateng Liu, Yuji Zhang, Zihan Wang, Yi R. (May) Fung, Manling Li, Heng Ji
arxiv-2508-21094.description: Abstract Humans naturally perform temporal screening by dragging the progress bar and focusing on salient temporal segments, but current Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) struggle to capture fine-grained temporal semantics due to sparse frame sampling and insufficient inter-frame reasoning supervision during their training.

arxiv-2601-20749.title: Learning to Live with AI: How Students Develop AI Literacy Through Naturalistic ChatGPT Interaction Journal: Computers and Education: Artificial Intelligence
arxiv-2601-20749.creator: Tawfiq Ammari, Meilun Chen, S M Mehedi Zaman, Kiran Garimella
arxiv-2601-20749.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Tawfiq Ammari, Meilun Chen, S M Mehedi Zaman, Kiran Garimella. How do students develop AI literacy through everyday practice rather than formal instruction? While normative AI literacy frameworks proliferate, empirical understanding of how students actually learn to work with generative AI remains limited. This study analyzes 10,536 ChatGPT messages from 36 undergraduates over one academic year, revealing five use genres—academic workhorse, emotional companion, metacognitive partner, repair and negotiation, and trust calibration—that constitute distinct configurations of student-AI learning.

pmc-10737286.creator: Youngmin Jee
pmc-10737286.description: Low Urinary Tract Symptoms(LUTS) is one of the common symptoms in older men and is important factor in terms of quality of life. The purpose of this research was to investigate the association between long-term exposure to air pollution and LUTS in korean older men.

pmc-11738963.description: AimsFloatation-REST (restricted environmental stimulation therapy) has shown promising potential as a therapeutic intervention in psychiatric conditions such as anxiety and anorexia nervosa. Within our lab, interoceptive trait prediction error has been used to predict states of anxiety in autistic adults.

pmc-13095125.title: Lactate and histone H3K18 lactylation are associated with metabolic control of gene expression in the retina
pmc-13095125.creator: Mohita Gaur, Matthew J. Brooks, Xulong Liang, Ke Jiang, Anjani Kumari, Milton A. English, Paolo Cifani, Maria C. Panepinto, Jacob Nellissery, Robert N. Fariss, Laura Campello, Claire Marchal, Anand Swaroop, Gregory S. Barsh, John M. Greally, Gregory S. Barsh, John M. Greally, Gregory S. Barsh, John
pmc-13095125.description: High aerobic glycolysis in retinal photoreceptors, as in cancer cells, is implicated in mitigating energy and metabolic demands. Lactate, a product of glycolysis, can exert epigenetic regulation through histone lactylation in cancer. Here, we show that enhanced ATP production during mouse retinal development is achieved primarily through increase in glycolysis.

pmc-13125666.title: Dominance and natural suppression of bacterial plant pathogens across global soils
pmc-13125666.creator: Min Gao, Manuel Delgado-Baquerizo, Chao Xiong, Tadeo Sáez-Sandino, Juntao Wang, Jinsong Liang, Emilio Guirado, Miriam Muñoz-Rojas, Raul Román, Fernando T. Maestre, Brajesh K. Singh
pmc-13125666.description: Soils are the primary environmental reservoir of plant pathogens impacting food production and ecosystem productivity worldwide. Yet, some soils can also suppress pathogens through environmental and microbial regulation. Here we integrate 1602 soil metagenomes from 59 countries with a greenhouse experiment to identify 32 dominant pathogens, including Ralstonia solanacearum, Clavibacter michiganensis, and Streptomyces europaeiscabiei.

pmc-13185714.title: GO/APTES-mediated bifunctional CuFe2O4@GO-NH2-facilitated synthesis of pyrazolo-triazepine scaffolds as a potent post-prandial antidiabetic agent against dual α-amylase and α-glucosidase enzymes
pmc-13185714.creator: Romica Jain, Ashok Kumar, Pratibha Sharma
pmc-13185714.description: Non-insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus (NIDDM) is a prevalent illness among individuals. This study elucidates the synthesis of pyrazolo-fused triazepine skeletons containing heterocycles and their assay-based in vitro and in silico antidiabetic activity against dual α-amylase and α-glucosidase enzymes followed by ab initio studies.

pmc-13564180.creator: Keju Ji, Xinran Xu, Jian Chen, Wenjie Chen, Xiaolei Zhu, Haixiang Ma, Xingyu Jiang, Changhong Linghu, Zhendong Dai
pmc-13564180.description: Mushroom‐shaped tip architectures play a central role in enhancing the performance of bionic adhesives by amplifying adhesion strength through optimized stress distribution and increased interfacial contact. However, current approaches for fabricating molds of complex adhesive structures are often constrained by high cost, limited repeatability, and limited ability to fabricate complex 3D geometries.

pmc-13613891.title: MXenes at the Immune Interface: A Perspective on Influence of Physicochemical Design in Immunomodulation
pmc-13613891.creator: Alireza Rafieerad, Leena Regi Saleth, Sanjiv Dhingra
pmc-13613891.description: MXenes are a recently discovered family of two-dimensional (2D) transition metal-based nanomaterials, known for their compositional diversity, exceptional tunability, structural versatility, and surface functionality. Beyond their well-established application in energy storage, MXenes have attracted growing interest for their promising role in regenerative biomedicine, particularly in antimicrobial and immune engineering applications.
